decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 23 March 2005, the erection of a single storey rear extension measuring 5.4 metres wide, 3.66 metres deep and 2.8 metres high to top of flat roof (3 metres high to top of parapets) and single storey shed 5.3 metres wide, 3.7 metres deep and 3 metres high to the top of the flat roof was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and 	Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Classes A and E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.

Condition : 2 - iNFORMATIVE:  The detached outbuilding hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwellinghouse known as 320 Wellington Road and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include toilet, bathroom or kitchen facilities).
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a single storey rear extension and detached single storey shed to rear of house
